items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Wilhelmina Bart, who is also dead, and a friend of mine, Ruby May Townsend

ctx.x: So, so you weren't the first woman to play the band. Oh, yes. Was there, did you see many women playing piano with bands around here out of the... Yes.
Mercedes Fields, who is dead now, and Wilhelmina Bart, who is also dead, and a friend of mine, Ruby May Townsend, who is also dead, all three of whom I can remember.
